title: OpenAI Funding on Track to Top $100 Billion in Latest Round
title_zh: OpenAI 最新一轮融资有望突破 1000 亿美元
summary: As the ChatGPT maker prepares to spend trillions in infrastructure investment, the overall valuation of the company, including the eventual funding, could exceed $850 billion, according to some of the people.
summary_zh: 一些知情人士称，随着 ChatGPT 制造商准备花费数万亿美元进行基础设施投资，该公司的整体估值（包括最终融资）可能会超过 8500 亿美元。

title: India's Tata signs up OpenAI as customer for data centre business
title_zh: 印度塔塔 (Tata) 与 OpenAI 签约成为数据中心业务客户
summary: OpenAI will become the first customer of India's ‌Tata Consultancy Services' data centre business, ‌beginning with 100 megawatts of capacity, part of the ​global AI infrastructure initiative Stargate, the companies said.
summary_zh: 两家公司表示，OpenAI 将成为印度塔塔咨询服务公司数据中心业务的首个客户，起始容量为 100 兆瓦，这是全球人工智能基础设施计划 Stargate 的一部分。

title: Meta's Zuckerberg denies at LA trial that Instagram targets kids
title_zh: Meta 的扎克伯格在洛杉矶审判中否认 Instagram 针对儿童
summary: STORY: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg testified in court on Wednesday that the Facebook and Instagram operator does not allow kids under 13 on its platforms…:: Mona Edwards…despite being confronted with evidence suggesting they were a key demographic.He took the stand as part of a&n...
summary_zh: 故事：Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格周三在法庭上作证说，Facebook 和 Instagram 运营商不允许 13 岁以下的儿童使用其平台……:: Mona Edwards……尽管有证据表明他们是关键人群。他出庭作证是为了……

title: Wall Street ends higher, lifted by Nvidia and other AI stocks
title_zh: 受英伟达和其他人工智能股票的提振，华尔街收高
summary: STORY: Wall Street ended higher on Wednesday, with the Dow adding about a quarter of a percent, the S&P 500gaining more than half a percent and the Nasdaq climbing over three-quarters of a percent.:: NvidiaNvidia rose more than 1.5% after the world's most valuable company said...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街周三收高，道指上涨约四分之一个百分点，标准普尔 500 指数上涨超过半个百分点，纳斯达克指数上涨超过四分之三。:: Nvidia 在全球最有价值的公司表示...后，Nvidia 上涨超过 1.5%。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures steady with Wall Street on win streak despite AI fears
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货稳定，尽管人工智能担忧，华尔街仍连续上涨
summary: Wall Street is set to wrap up a difficult earnings season as Trump rails against the New York Fed.
summary_zh: 随着特朗普对纽约联储的批评，华尔街即将结束一个艰难的财报季。

title: Why Meta's addiction trial could be bellwether for similar lawsuits
title_zh: 为什么 Meta 的成瘾审判可能成为类似诉讼的风向标
summary: Meta Platforms (META) CEO Mark Zuckerberg testified before a Los Angeles court on Wednesday in a civil lawsuit claiming the tech giant's social media platforms — such as Instagram and Facebook — harm younger users and get them addicted to the apps.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 周三在洛杉矶一家法院的民事诉讼中作证，指控这家科技巨头的社交媒体平台（例如 Instagram 和 Facebook）伤害了年轻用户，并使他们沉迷于这些应用程序。

title: Atlassian names LinkedIn veteran James Chuong as CFO
title_zh: Atlassian 任命 LinkedIn 资深人士 James Chuong 为首席财务官
summary: Atlassian on Wednesday named James Chuong as its new ‌chief financial officer, effective March ‌30, taking over from Joe Binz. Chuong, 46, will ​join the enterprise software company after over a decade as the finance chief of LinkedIn, a subsidiary of Microsoft.
summary_zh: Atlassian 周三任命 James Chuong 为其新任首席财务官，自 3 月 30 日起生效，接替 Joe Binz。 46 岁的 Chuong 在微软子公司 LinkedIn 担任财务主管十多年后，将加入这家企业软件公司。

title: Transports, Apple's AI plans, oil prices: Market Takeaways
title_zh: 交通、苹果的人工智能计划、油价：市场要点
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) closed Wednesday's session in positive territory — the Nasdaq Composite leading the way in gains — as investors ease up around AI worries tied to last week's sell-off in the software sector.
summary_zh: 美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）周三收盘上涨，纳斯达克综合指数领涨，投资者缓解了上周软件行业抛售引发的人工智能担忧。

title: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg testifies in teen social media addiction suit
title_zh: Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格在青少年社交媒体成瘾诉讼中作证
summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg will take the stand Wednesday as part of a major social media lawsuit.
summary_zh: Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格将于周三出庭作证，作为一场重大社交媒体诉讼的一部分。
